meta.title: HLR Step 1b numeric census

source.frame_lists: /mnt/user-data/uploads/highlight-brandbook/outputs/step-1-review/figma/frames-{email,social,paid,web}.tsv (rows of type frame; these include GROUP nodes)

method: Read-only use_figma scripts: getNodeByIdAsync, page.loadAsync, getStyledTextSegments, property reads only. No writes.

A node is skipped when it or any ancestor up to the frame is hidden (visible false). Text whose box lies wholly outside the frame is skipped as off-canvas. Whitespace-only text and segments are skipped.

Type key = family|style|size|case|tracking % of size|line height px or AUTO. Segments are coalesced runs with identical type fields. case "caps typed (ORIGINAL)" = textCase ORIGINAL but every letter typed upper case.
Percentiles are nearest-rank over segments (type) or text nodes (insets). Small-text counts are segments strictly under each canvas px threshold.
Ink = topmost visible paint of each coalesced fill run; @NN = paint opacity %.

Ground = topmost solid fill of the largest visible RECTANGLE or FRAME descendant covering at least 50% of the frame (it paints over the frame), else the frame own fill; "none" = no fill (GROUP frames), IMG = image fill. Photo cover = share of a 32x32 sample grid inside visible IMAGE or VIDEO fills: full_bleed >= 90%, partial > 0.
Insets: text box (absoluteBoundingBox) to each frame edge, and ink (absoluteRenderBounds) to each edge; negative = text past the edge.

CTA candidate = visible FRAME, RECTANGLE or INSTANCE with a visible stroke or a solid fill, narrower than 60% of frame width, shorter than 200 px x width/1200, overlapping exactly one visible text of 4 words or fewer. Boxes with no stroke whose fill equals the parent fill or the frame ground are excluded (invisible wrappers). Several boxes on one label merge into one candidate (geometry from the largest; stroke and fill from the largest that has them). Label font is family plus style (style added to the requested key). Padding = average gap from box edge to label ink.
Corner radii count every visible descendant with a visible fill or stroke and a cornerRadius property (frame itself excluded). Top 10 values.
Email outer margin: body size per group = font size with the most characters among texts of 8 or more words; texts within 15% of that size; box left and right insets.
scope_notes: Frames inside nested sections are not in the frame lists (verified: the lists equal the direct FRAME and GROUP children of each top-level section by count and id checksum). They are reported as extra groups flagged in_frame_list false: social "sept-october 2026" holds 16 dated sub-sections with 111 frames; paid "Section 1" holds 4 sub-sections with 38 frames.
No group failed to read. All 2,092 listed frames were found.

CTA candidates in social strips and paid boards are carousel panels or mock UI bars (an Instagram reply bar), not CTAs. One label carried a third-party account handle and is written as [third-party handle].
